title: Vegan Mediterranean Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and healthy vegan stir fry recipe made with Mediterranean herbs and wholesome ingredients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the Mediterranean herbs and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 3-4 minutes, until they start to release their juices.
Add the brown rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the tomatoes and herbs.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the rice is heated through.
Season with lemon zest and serve hot.
